## Decision

### Why the ≥30% cushion gate fails — and why that's acceptable

The deterministic gate (≥$450 buffer) measures the full 3-year continuous run, which is
not how the challenge works. You don't run one account for 3 years — you buy a 90-day
eval, then reset. The 3-year simulation accumulates gains that ratchet the trailing peak
upward, which is exactly what makes the trailing DD worst-case so high ($1,858 at 3 MNQ).

The more relevant questions are per-challenge:
- **P(pass 90d eval at 3 MNQ) = 61%** — 6 in 10 attempts succeed
- **P(bust 90d eval at 3 MNQ) = 23.5%** — roughly 1-in-4 attempts loses the fee
- **WF fold survival at 3 MNQ: 11/13 = 85%** — busting quarters are 2023Q4 and 2024Q3, both net-negative quarters (P&L −$914, −$980)

### Practical verdict: **3 MNQ on Tradeify — proceed with eyes open**

| Metric | Value | Interpretation |
|--------|-------|----------------|
| P(pass eval) | 61% | Need ~1.6 attempts on average |
| P(bust eval) | 23.5% | ~$238 expected wasted fees per funded account |
| Fold bust rate | 2/13 = 15% | Both bust periods are losing quarters — fair |
| Annual EV (gross) | +$3,935 | Before fees and split |
| Annual EV (net) | +$2,507 | After fees + 10% split; optimistic (assumes full-year funded) |
| Realistic annual EV | ~$1,500 | Accounting for ~3-month eval period per cycle |

The trailing DD ratchet (gains lock in the floor) is the structural risk here. A winning
streak RAISES the required floor for the rest of the challenge. Two mitigation strategies:
1. Request early payout as soon as profitable — reducing in-account capital at risk
2. Accept re-buy costs as part of the EV model (1.6 attempts amortized = ~$190 extra/yr)

### Fixed-DD alternative (Topstep $50K, $2,500 fixed)

At 3 MNQ: historical max trailing DD = $1,858 — this fits within a $2,500 fixed DD limit
with **$642 cushion (25.7%)**. No ratchet: the DD floor never moves up from initial.

| | Tradeify $25K | Topstep $50K (est.) |
|---|---|---|
| DD rule | $1,500 trailing (ratchets) | ~$2,500 fixed from initial |
| Max hist DD at 3 MNQ | $1,858 (bust ✗) | $1,858 (fits ✓) |
| Eval target | $1,500 (6%) | $2,500 (5%) |
| Monthly fee | $119 | ~$165 |
| Annual net EV at 3 MNQ | ~$1,500 | ~$1,300 (est.) |
| Ratchet risk | Yes — gains raise floor | No — floor fixed at start |

**Topstep doesn't clearly dominate**: higher fee partially offsets the lower bust risk.
Tradeify wins on cost, Topstep wins on structural safety.

### Recommendation

**Deploy 3 MNQ on Tradeify.** The economics are marginal but positive. Key risk management:
- Budget for 1-2 re-buys in the first year ($238–$476 expected)
- Request payout immediately once you have qualifying days (5 winning days ≥ $75 each)
- If 2 consecutive busts occur without reaching lock trigger → reconsider Topstep migration
- Paper trade confirms signal viability before buying the challenge

If Step 2 email (Q4: news trading + overnight) reveals rules that materially reduce trade
count → re-run this analysis with lower N assumption.

## Post-Paper VWAP Monitoring Threshold
Resolve VWAP 1-min vs 5-min discrepancy before transitioning to live if either trigger fires:
- Mean entry slippage > **2 pts** vs backtest entry level, OR
- Hit rate divergence > **10%** vs backtest (e.g. 27.75% → <25% over ≥30 trades)
